title: Daqar qaxal tan rooci dacrisa
intro: qunxa rooci sirri farmo luk suge, amaan le baxxook yabloonuh sarrimaane leeh amol fakkimte. ambullee waytam kee daremsime waytam, ta muuci agat aydaadih korsi milaaguh kaxxa doori digirta.
clues: Anu yiinah taama yoh teceeh, uqrat kee cubbi faxxa taama.
intiita yok qunxa qarkayto katayteh awayyih uddur, yi sorkocobaxi qilsih bohoyut.
qammalsime wayta massoyna geyte wak, anu xayyooweh, meysi kibuk yan.
Anu ken qaago yirgiqeenim ubleh kee numma baxxaqise kalah fidga xayyoyse.
yi waktil gaba culsi nersing rooci wadirih gacse tiyay kaxxam faxak suge.
Caylale marih cokmih buxal, anu edde yaabem: 'Anu kaa qimmissah tan buxah marah koo miraacisam kee kaa dacrisaanam faxximta?'

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Is alqi isi ina lih qagitak tasgallem
outcome.answer: Is alqi isi ina lih qagitak tasgallem

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
